Long, flowing deep crimson hair with straight bangs and a glossy texture. Sharp, narrow deep amber eyes with a confident gaze. Appears as a mature adult with a refined facial structure. Slender, graceful build. A high-slit traditional Japanese kimono in a deep crimson and black palette with gold floral accents. Large, ornate red rigging apparatus with mechanical arms and heavy artillery floating behind the back.
BODY COLOR: fair skin
